children.value: > Fact From Story: Ellison was the head of Alameda Research, the aforementioned hedge fund, during the implosion of it and FTX.
> > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried directed alleged co-conspirator Caroline Ellison to repay third-party loans and went on making investments.
> > > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried’s employees told him “they were busy and I should stop asking questions because it was distracting.”
> > > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried didn’t ask where the $8 billion went
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A good CEO would be concerned about billions of dollars of missing money.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: This indicates that Ellison was taking direction from Bankman-Fried.

> Fact From Story: I’ve got some shitty ex-boyfriends, but none of them made me the CEO of their sin-eater hedge fund while refusing to give me equity and bragging about how there was a 5 percent chance they’d become the president of the United States, you know?

> > Fact From Story: She’s already pleaded guilty to criminal charges stemming from one of the worst romantic relationships I’ve ever heard of, and her testimony was widely anticipated before the trial.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A good romantic relationship does not result in one person pleading guilty to criminal charges.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A good boyfriend would value his girlfriend and treat her well.
